newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moslem cleric jailed in France for exorcism killing.
newsitem.headline: Moslem cleric jailed in France for exorcism killing.

text.p: A Franco-Algerian imam (Moslem cleric) was sentenced to seven years imprisonement by a French court on Friday for his role in the death of a teenage girl during an exorcism ceremony.
Another man got a four-year-sentence while the victim's brother, who attended the session during which Louisa Lardjoune, 19, suffered injuries which killed her in June 1994, was acquitted.

The court was told the victim's family appealed for help from Mohamed Kerzazi, imam of a fundamentalist mosque near the town of Roubaix, on the grounds that Lardjoune's body was "inhabited by a 'djinn' (demon.")

Kerzazi, aided by Morad Selmane, the other man sentenced, directed a five-hour exorcism session during which the victim was beaten on the soles of her feet with bamboo staves and forcibly made to drink large amounts of salt water.
She began spitting blood and went into a coma before being taken to hospital where she died the next day, the court heard.
